tools.description: Real traded price from live venue(s) (SafeTrade): bid/ask/mid/last/index. Thin single venue; distinct from the /price model.

tools.description: Coin-age & balance cohorts, net-flow, HODL waves, optionally priced. price=model|market.

tools.description: Multi-chain wBTX bridged supply + reserve/backing signal. TESTNET only.

tools.name: wbtx_reconcile

tools.name: trace
tools.description: Bounded fund tracer forward/back from a txid. Proportional flow share on provable edges — never an ownership claim.

tools.name: cluster
tools.description: [PRO/Enterprise token required] Co-spend set: addresses that were inputs together with this one. NOT proof of common ownership.

tools.name: liquidity
tools.description: [PRO/Enterprise token required] PRO. Liquidity/float funnel: recently-moved supply estimate vs single-venue book depth. A float proxy, not price discovery.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: [PRO/Enterprise token required] Enterprise. Usage mix: on-chain value bucketed into neutral activity categories with trends.

instructions:
First Light MCP exposes the BTX (Byron Bay pool) explorer chain-intelligence API
as native tools, auto-discovered from the live API catalog (/api/_catalog).

NEUTRAL-FACTS CONTRACT (hard product principle): every tool returns provable
on-chain observations ONLY. Never present a result as an identity, ownership,
holdings, counterparty, accusation, risk verdict, or advice. Each result carries
a `caveat` field (from the API, or the canonical caveat if the endpoint omits one)
and a `framing` note — surface them; do not strip, summarize, or relocate them.

AUTH: public tools work with no token. Tools marked PRO/Enterprise require a valid
`FIRST_LIGHT_TOKEN` (Bearer key). If a gated tool is called without a usable token
the result is a clean `{ error: 'auth' | 'tier', ... }` object, not data.
